fields.Name: Skip ICF - Organization Member Activity
fields.Description: Organizations with 5+ ICF members and their combined conference, course and committee activity. Ported from "Organization Member Activity Summary".

InputDefinition.userMessage: For each organization that has 5 or more ICF members working there, show me the organization name, member count, and their members' combined activity: conferences attended, course enrollments and committee memberships. Display as a table ranked by total activity. Let me click an organization to see its members and their individual activity. [NO CHAT]

judgeValidationCriteria: Response includes a table of organizations with at least 5 members (about 69 organizations)
Member-to-organization link uses Member Profiles OrganizationID (or the employee relationship)
Activity combines conference attendance, course enrollments and committee memberships
Organizations are ranked by total activity
Clicking an organization shows its members with per-member activity counts
Rows in the member table can open the underlying person or member profile record
